name: Manager creates a SIM that appears in the SIMs list
description: A manager adds a new SIM (شرائح) from the SIMs screen by entering a unique ICCID, phone number and choosing a provider, and the created SIM becomes visible at the top of the SIMs list.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Log in with username manager and password Yt@12345
Wait for the manager dashboard to load
Open the SIMs section (شرائحي / شرائح SIM) from the manager navigation
Enter a unique ICCID, a phone number, and pick Yemen Mobile as the provider, leaving the status as available
Verify the newly created SIM appears in the SIMs list with the entered ICCID and available status
